panels.title: ActiveRecord Connection Pool

panels.description: Sidekiq retry and dead queue depths — growing dead queue means jobs failing permanently
panels.title: Sidekiq Retry / Dead Queue
P95 Latency (ms)
panels.description: 95th-percentile response time. 5% of users wait at least this long — invisible to the average but critical for perceived app speed.

panels.title: Puma Thread Saturation (%)
panels.description: Busy Puma threads / max threads. At 100% new requests queue at the OS level before Rails even sees them.

panels.title: Sidekiq Queue Depth (jobs)
panels.description: Total jobs waiting in the Sidekiq enqueued queue. A growing queue means workers cannot keep pace.

panels.title: Sidekiq Queue Latency (s)
panels.description: Age of the oldest unprocessed job. Spikes here mean workers are stuck or blocked on a slow resource.

panels.title: InnoDB Buffer Pool Miss Rate (%)
panels.description: Cache miss rate — % of reads served from disk rather than RAM. >1% means MySQL is disk-bound; increase innodb_buffer_pool_size.

panels.title: MySQL Deadlocks (/min)
panels.description: InnoDB deadlocks per minute. Even 1/min causes application retries and degraded write throughput.

panels.title: MySQL Aborted Connections (/min)
panels.description: Failed connection attempts per minute. High values indicate Rails pool timeout, wrong credentials, or max_connections exceeded.
